site.name: Semiconductor Intelligence Desk
site.tagline: A trilingual research desk for the global semiconductor value chain
site.description: A Chinese–English–Japanese research dashboard covering 8 value-chain stages, 11 headquarters regions and 120+ companies, with verifiable quotes, structure, knowledge and method.

home.title: Value chain, companies, cycles and knowledge on one desk
home.lede: From EDA to advanced packaging, from mainland China to Japan, Korea, Taiwan, the US and Europe, read the industry through one consistent framework. Every figure carries a source and a coverage flag; every conclusion carries a method and a boundary.

regime.title: Market state
regime.desc: A composite of breadth, median return and dispersion. It describes the current structure; it does not forecast direction.
regime.thresholds: Thresholds: expansion when breadth ≥ 60% and median return > 2%; contraction when breadth ≤ 40% and median return < -2%; otherwise neutral.

chain.title: Value-chain structure
chain.desc: Company count, market cap and 30-day performance by stage. Equipment and materials are support layers, not sequential steps.

movers.title: Momentum extremes
movers.desc: Ranked by 30-session return, excluding companies with incomplete data. Momentum describes price behaviour, not fundamentals.

scatter.title: Valuation vs quality
scatter.desc: X-axis: static P/E. Y-axis: ROE. Bubble area: market cap. Only companies with positive P/E and complete fields are shown.

watchlist.title: Research list
watchlist.desc: Generated from published rules to sequence reading. Not a recommendation.

news.title: Industry signals
news.desc: Headlines, sources and links from allowlisted publishers only. No full-text copying.
news.empty: No usable headlines were retrieved in this build; the snapshot is shown instead.
news.sourceNote: Headline copyright remains with the original publisher.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.desc: From process and equipment to cycles and policy, structured notes build a shared language.

method.title: Method and boundaries
method.desc: Scores only order research: factor definitions, normalisation, weights and thresholds are public, and nothing here is investment advice.

companies.title: Company map
companies.lede: One table for the position, quotes and data quality of the world's major semiconductor companies. Quotes are delayed or closing prices; valuation uses static P/E and P/B.

company.dataNote: Data comes from public quote APIs, using the latest available close and financial metrics. Missing fields show as —; coverage reflects field completeness, not accuracy.
company.unpriced: No verified quote source is available for this company. The research entry is kept, but it is excluded from quote statistics.
company.positioningTemplate: {name} sits in the {stage} stage and operates as a {role} company, with capabilities spanning {products}.
company.priorityDesc: Each factor is a percentile within peers; missing factors are renormalised.

chain.title: The value chain
chain.lede: Semiconductors are not a straight line but a network of a main flow and support layers. Understanding how each stage earns money and which metrics bind it matters more than memorising company names.
chain.note: Stages are assigned by primary revenue source. A company may both design and manufacture; only its main classification is used here.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.lede: Semiconductor industry knowledge organised by theme. Each note stands alone and complements the research list. Industry explanation only, not investment advice.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.lede: Semiconductor terms with Chinese, English and Japanese definitions, to remove ambiguity across markets.

method.title: Method
method.lede: This desk is a research tool first and a data product second. The rules below determine every number and ordering you see.
method.purpose: It answers three questions within limited time: what state is this stage in, which companies deserve reading first, and is the data behind my judgement complete?
method.not: No buy/sell calls, price targets or position sizing. No earnings forecasts. No single-factor conclusions dressed up as answers. No hiding of missing data.
method.universe: 120+ listed semiconductor companies, classified into 8 stages by primary revenue source. Each company keeps one primary listing to avoid double counting. Additions and removals are recorded in the data files.
method.factors: All factors are percentile-normalised to 0–100 within the peer set, then weighted into a research priority score. Percentiles are computed within a stage; stages with fewer than 8 companies fall back to the full sample.
method.factorValue: Inverse percentile of static P/E; P/E ≤ 0 is treated as missing and the remaining weights are renormalised.
method.factorMomentum: 60% × percentile of 30-session return + 40% × percentile of 52-week range position.
method.factorSize: Percentile of log market cap in USD, a proxy for liquidity and resilience.
method.scoreFormula: Research priority = 0.30 × quality + 0.25 × valuation + 0.25 × momentum + 0.20 × size
method.confidence: Coverage is the share of 8 fields present (price, 1D, 30D, market cap, P/E, P/B, ROE, 52-week range): ≥ 87.5% high, ≥ 62.5% medium, otherwise low. Coverage measures completeness, not accuracy.
method.regime: Breadth, median 30-day return and dispersion describe structure. Thresholds are fixed and public so calls can be reviewed; the state does not forecast returns.
method.limits: Quotes are delayed or closing prices, with no intraday signal. Static P/E penalises high-growth companies. Revenue growth and order data are missing. Classification involves editorial judgement. FX conversion carries daily error.
method.disclaimer: This desk is for industry research and learning only and is not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Data may be delayed or wrong; always verify with exchange filings and company announcements.

about.title: About
about.lede: A research desk built on public data and public method, so that conversations about semiconductors share a common language.
about.mission: Semiconductors combine high technical barriers, deep cycles and geopolitics. This desk compresses scattered value-chain knowledge, company positions and market data into a verifiable surface, helping readers build structural intuition faster.
about.audience: Students and researchers learning the value chain, analysts and practitioners who need a fast global view, and individual investors who want transparent data definitions.
about.scope: 8 value-chain stages, 11 headquarters regions and 120+ listed companies across mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, the US, Japan, Korea and Europe.
about.sources: Quotes, valuation and 52-week ranges come from Eastmoney public quote APIs; FX from open.er-api.com; industry signals from allowlisted publisher RSS. Everything is written into a build-time snapshot; pages never call third-party APIs.
about.cadence: Automated refresh once per trading day; weekly anomaly review; monthly universe and classification review; quarterly method and documentation review.
about.license: Code is MIT licensed, written content is CC BY 4.0, and market data remains the property of its providers. Cite SiliconScope with the access date.
about.contribute: Data corrections, glossary additions and documentation improvements are welcome. Include a verifiable source and state the scope of impact.
about.disclaimer: No investment advice, target prices or return promises. Anyone acting on this content does so at their own risk.
